headline.purpose: Section headings across storefront and admin.

body.purpose: Default UI, table, and content text.

label.purpose: Buttons, badges, form labels, table headers.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: Default resting elevation for storefront (Persuade) cards: product cards, category tiles, promo panels. Always present, not hover-only.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Hover/focus lift for storefront cards, paired with a small upward translate — real tactile weight.

shadows.name: panel-md
shadows.purpose: Floating/overlay context (e.g. a filter panel) that needs to read as sitting above the page.

motion.name: default-transition
motion.purpose: Tailwind's default `transition` utility — used for color/background hover state changes on buttons, links, and cards. No custom easing curve is defined; the system does not use bespoke motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Signal-red pill CTA — the highest-commitment action on a screen (add to cart, pay now, submit).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #e6212a; color: #ffffff; font-family: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #bd1b22; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ffffff, 0 0 0 4px #e6212a; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #d4d4d4; color: #a3a3a3; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard bordered text field used across storefront forms and admin CRUD — border shifts to Signal Red on focus, always paired with a visible ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #ffffff; color: #171717; font-family: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #d4d4d4; border-radius: 8px; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #e6212a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #e6212a; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #a3a3a3; }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Clickable product tile — flat at rest, a subtle shadow lift on hover confirms interactivity without simulating physical elevation.
components.html: Lampu LED H4 6000KRp185.000
components.css: .ds-card { display: block; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e5e5e5; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; transition: box-shadow 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); border-color: #e6212a; } .ds-card-media { aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; background: #f5f5f4; } .ds-card-body { padding: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #171717; } .ds-card-price { font-family: Poppins, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; color: #e6212a; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Fixed color-per-status pill used for order status, payment status, and active/archived state across every admin table — semantic, never brand red.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-badge-success { background: #dcfce7; color: #15803d; } .ds-badge-pending { background: #fef3c7; color: #b45309; } .ds-badge-progress { background: #dbeafe; color: #1d4ed8; }

components.name: Section Heading Accent
components.description: Signature small red bar above a section heading — the system's controlled, minimal echo of the logo's sunburst/bar device. Signature component: not a generic pattern.
components.css: .ds-section-heading { display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-heading-accent { display: block; height: 4px; width: 40px; margin-bottom: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #e6212a; } .ds-section-heading h2 { font-family: Poppins, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; color: #171717; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview:
BHINEKALED reads like a headlight cutting through the dark: high-contrast, direct, no ambiguity about where to look. The system is built almost entirely flat — near-black text and near-white surfaces, with signal red used sparingly as the one thing that must never be missed (a price, a CTA, an active state). It doesn't reach for gradients, glass, or layered shadows to feel modern; confidence comes from restraint, generous rounding, and a single loud color used with discipline.

The system draws directly from the logo: a bold rounded wordmark, a white outline holding red back from the edge, and a sunburst motif standing in for "menyala" — the sense of something switching on. Section accents (the short red bar above headings) are a deliberately small, controlled echo of that sunburst/bar device, not a decorative flourish invented from scratch.
keyCharacteristics: Two elevation registers by mode: storefront (Persuade) surfaces are tactile — product/category cards carry real resting shadow and lift further on hover; admin (Operate) surfaces stay flat and bordered for scanability and density.
One brand red, used with confidence: large-scale hero/banner fills and promo tiles on the storefront, plus every CTA, price, and active state — still never diluted into a secondary accent color.
Generous, consistent rounding (pill buttons, rounded-lg/rounded-xl cards) — sharp 90° corners are treated as off-brand, not just unstyled.

A separate, semantic status-color layer (amber/green/blue) exists alongside the brand palette for order and payment states — those hues are functional, not brand accents, and must not be confused with or replace brand red.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Signal Red is the only red anywhere in the interface — destructive actions, CTA hovers, hero fills, promo tiles, and every red-adjacent state derive from #e6212a/#bd1b22, never from Tailwind's stock red-* scale or a second accent hue. Bold, page-scale use is welcome on storefront surfaces; what's never welcome is a second color trying to do the same job.

rules.name: The Two-Family Rule
rules.body: Exactly two font families exist in the system (Poppins for headings, Inter for everything else). A third family is never introduced for "emphasis" — weight and the display/body split carry all the hierarchy the system needs.

rules.name: The Two-Register Rule
rules.body: Elevation follows mode, not screen-by-screen taste: every storefront card rests on shadow-sm and lifts to shadow-lg on hover; every admin panel stays flat and bordered at every state. Moving a component between modes without re-deciding its elevation is a defect, not a style choice.

dos: Do use Signal Red (#e6212a) as the only red in the interface, including hover and destructive states — always via the brand-red/brand-red-hover tokens, never a raw hex or stock Tailwind red.
Do give storefront cards a resting shadow-sm that lifts to shadow-lg on hover — depth is a tactile shopping cue there, not an occasional accent.
Do keep admin surfaces flat and bordered at every state — the Two-Register Rule applies in both directions.
Do keep every focusable control's focus:outline-none paired with focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand-red — never strip the outline without replacing it.
Do use the amber/green/blue status palette exclusively for order/payment/active-state communication, kept visually distinct from brand red so "urgent action" and "current status" are never confused.
Do round generously and consistently (pill for actions/status, rounded-lg+ for containers, rounded-md for form controls) — this is a brand commitment from the logo, not a default to soften later.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent color "just for variety" — the system's confidence comes from one brand hue used boldly, not from adding hues.
Don't add resting shadows to admin panels, badges, or buttons — the tactile register is a storefront-only device.
Don't use sharp, unrounded corners anywhere a rounded equivalent is available — this directly contradicts the logo's rounded, bold character.
Don't introduce a third font family. Poppins carries all display/heading weight; Inter carries everything else.
